Step into charm with this T-Bar Mary Jane, featuring a recycled mesh lining for breathability and a deep-lugged outsole for grip. Classic fringe adds timeless elegance to every tiny step. 

• Navy suede leather upper.  

• Breathable, recycled mesh lining allows air flow, therefore promoting healthy foot climate. 

• Leather-lined insole conforms to the shape of the foot and promotes breathability. 

• Natural rubber cupsole outsole with deep lugged multi-directional chevron pattern provides great traction for play.  

• Awarded the Seal of Acceptance from the American Podiatric Medical Association (APMA). 

• Care Instructions: Spot clean using a mild detergent and damp cloth. Allow to air dry.
